Tests that streaming requests bypass cache entirely

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.literllm.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        var reqJson = "{\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Hello\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"gpt-4\"}";
        var req = JsonUtil.fromJson(reqJson, ChatCompletionRequest.class);
        try (var client = LiterLlm.createClientFromJson("{\"api_key\":\"your-api-key\",\"cache\":{\"backend\":\"memory\",\"max_entries\":256,\"ttl_seconds\":300}}")) {
        var result = client.chatStream(req);
        try (result) {
        result.forEach(resultChunk -> {
        System.out.println(resultChunk);
        });
        }
        }
    }
}
```
